title: Indwelling of the Holy Spirit
definition: The indwelling of the Holy Spirit means that God permanently dwells within every true believer.
summary: The Spirit's indwelling marks believers as belonging to God. He comforts, strengthens, convicts, teaches, and empowers them for faithful living.
christFocus: The Spirit unites believers to Christ and applies the blessings of Christ's saving work to their lives.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: The Spirit's indwelling marks believers as belonging to God. He comforts, strengthens, convicts, teaches, and empowers them for faithful living.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers know God rightly, follow Christ faithfully, and avoid confusion in doctrine and daily life.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, compare it with Scripture, bring it into prayer, and let it shape your worship, obedience, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
